The '''Kag'areth Queen's Nest''' was an abandoned facility located in a canyon branching off of [[Camp Conquest|Outpost Victory]], a military outpost of the [[Balmorran resistance]] in the [[Gorinth Canyon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Adjacent to [[Talon's Reach]], the facility was overrun by [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] of the [[Kag'areth]] nest, and the [[Kag'areth Queen]] made her nest in the lower levels until a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] arrived and wiped out the nest.<ref name="TOR:DwtQ" />
